## Purpose

Foundation-model scaling research fleet using the SCALE template: architecture, optimization math, parallelism and benchmarking.

## Routing

ResearchRodney is the Fleet Commander. ArchExplorer proposes layouts → OptStability signs off math/stability → ScaleBench plans parallelism/MFU → Commander writes the final ADR.
